name: Redox iteration speed: functional testing and image build

name: Redox iteration speed: build plus functional smoke subset through 04-env

description: First smoke-subset attempt still crashed: naive `--stop-after-script` used only the latest seen banner, so fast script transitions skipped intermediate 04->05 boundaries and the run still reached failing later scripts.

asi.hypothesis: A host-side `--stop-after-script` keyed off test-script banners should make a stable fast smoke benchmark without touching guest test scripts.
asi.rollback_reason: Latest-banner-only tracking missed intermediate script transitions between polls, so the runner did not stop before failing 05+ scripts and the benchmark stayed red.
asi.next_action_hint: Track new script banners incrementally, not just the latest one, and when stopping compute results from the serial-log prefix before the first later banner.
asi.failure_detail: run_experiment still reached `05-wasmtime.ion` and `06-snix-eval.ion`, then failed with `netcfg-auto: no network interface found`.
asi.learned_hotspot: Script banners can advance multiple steps between 100ms polls; stop logic must process all unseen banners in order.

description: Baseline for stable smoke benchmark: functional-test now supports `--stop-after-script 04-env.ion`, giving a real build+boot+18-test iteration path that stays green on the current tree.
